statement: The ask path of act/prompt.mjs now tries a direct table first and the knowledge tier before any model cell. On the 200 held-out first-sentence facts of the knowledge bar's draw (seed knowledge-draw-2026-09-23), asked through ask() with the model cell offline, 122 were answered correctly at recall@1 with provenance memory or direct and no model call (61.0%, the bar is 100); 176 came from the direct table in one lookup, and 176 of those 176 gave the answer the tier alone gave. The same questions scored 122 with the tier alone, 122 with a control table that holds every title but the drawn ones (0 direct hits), 0 with the tier and the table off, and 18 when the answer is the title's own last word. The table memoises the tier: it was filled by asking the tier "What is <title>?" for 284749 titles, the drawn titles among them, and none of the hidden sentences was ever in the store. After one unrecorded warm pass, native answers took a mean 42.6 microseconds a whole ask with the table on, 1806.4 with the tier alone and 1475 with the control table. Over 1000000 lookups a run the table took a median 70.92 ns a hit and 25.75 ns a miss, measured with process.hrtime.bigint on a shared machine. The tasks suites scored 724 of 725 before and 724 of 725 after, and of the 724 suite questions ask() answered exactly and correctly before the change, 0 were lost with the table off and 0 with it on. The semantic tier is now bounded by a declared 256 MB byte budget, room for 15416 named keys, instead of 4,096 keys.
